ajustes.idioma.desc: Changes the language of the whole interface, the manual and the server messages. The page reloads when you change it.
ajustes.idioma.nota_log: What is already written to disk is not translated: the log and the history of earlier jobs stay in the language they had.
ajustes.idioma.nota_pistas: The language also decides which track profile new projects start with, and the language the track names are written in inside the MKV. The profile can be changed per project.
